facts.fact: 九年前的六月，Billie 决定告诉继母 Eloise 和父亲她要搬走：好友 Maggie 已开始转学纽约，两人找好了不贵的公寓，她的存款够撑几个月。
facts.anchor: Today’s the day I tell them I’m leaving.

facts.fact: Billie 向两人宣布：Maggie 转入了 NYU，她们将住在布鲁克林；公寓租约昨天已签，十一天后（eleven days）动身。
facts.anchor: We found an apartment. We signed a lease yesterday. I leave in eleven days.

facts.fact: 继母 Eloise 斥这是 Billie 一生最荒唐之举，讥讽她没有正经工作、抵达次日那场咖啡店面试纯属浪费时间，预言她注定失败。
facts.anchor: You’ve done a lot of stupid things in your life, Billie, but this is the most ridiculous of all.

facts.fact: 继母恶言说早知如此绝不会嫁给 Billie 的父亲，还骂她是被惯坏的废物；Billie 回敬「我不嫁你俩会过得更好」，彻底激怒对方。
facts.anchor: if I could go back, I never would’ve married your dad if I knew what I was getting into with you

facts.fact: 转折：继母 Eloise 抬手狠狠扇了 Billie 一记耳光；Billie 强忍没还手，反笑着问「Happy now」，让一贯掌控局面的 Eloise 第一次愣住。
facts.anchor: Before I can take a breath, I feel her hand forcefully come across my face.

facts.fact: 父亲涨红着脸全程一言不发，任继母扇女儿耳光也不保护；Billie 怒喊「You aren’t going to do anything?!」后冲回房间，抓起床下的薰衣草色行李袋开始收拾，打算搬走前先借住好友 Maggie 家。
facts.anchor: He’s not protecting me. He let her slap me across the face.

facts.fact: Billie 含泪说要去 Maggie 家借住到搬家；父亲跟进房只挤出一句「I’m sorry」，又低声求她「Please don’t tell anyone about this」，她怒斥他与继母一样坏。
facts.anchor: I’m going to Maggie’s. I’ll be fine,” I say rigidly through the tears.

facts.fact: Billie 对继母撂下「Have a nice life」并竖中指冲出家门；她本不想丢下父亲，但认定这是逃离 Eloise 的唯一办法，并料定继母会对外篡改这段往事。
facts.anchor: Have a nice life, Eloise,” I say, storming out the front door throwing her my middle finger.
